text: It's actually snowing on the deck. Red Hot Chili Peppers, Snow, the Hey Oh one. Gerrit's standing in it on one leg, looking betrayed.
Waves over the bow and the aerial whistling. The Kooks, Stormy Weather, and for once the title's doing the forecast.
Not a cloud anywhere, and here's Stormy Weather by The Kooks. Somebody has to keep the sea on its toes.
A storm proper out there, the boat bucking on her chain. The Doors, Riders On The Storm. [quietly] I've tied the mug down.
Rain on the wheelhouse roof and nothing out there but the lighthouse going round. Riders On The Storm, The Doors. Seven minutes. Stay.
Rain on the glass, so it might as well be Liverpool. Racoon, Liverpool Rain.
Showers coming through, with gaps in between. Acda en de Munnik, Het Regent Zonnestralen. Watch for the light in the gaps.
Morning, and Opa's been coughing since first light. Django Django, First Light. [dryly] Fitting.
Clear night, more stars than I can name, and I can name three. Muse, Starlight.
The wind's got hold of the aerial, and Gerrit's given up sitting on it. Louise Attaque, J't'emmène au vent. Take me with it, why not.
Warm out, the deck hot under bare feet. The Kooks, Seaside. Short as a dip off the stern, and just as good.
Late on anchor watch, everything dark but the lighthouse. Golden Earring, Radar Love, a song for driving through the night. I'll drive the boat in circles round her chain.
